te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_german_alemannic_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_german_alemannic
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_german_alemannic
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_german_alemannic_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_german_alemannic
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_german_alemannic
			var:te_cm_held_german_alemannic < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
						te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
						te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
					}

	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_german

			has_variable = te_cm_sol_german_alemannic

		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_sol_wide

			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_german
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_german
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_german_alemannic
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_german_opt_alemannic_sol_close
	}
	text = {

			NOT = {

			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_german_alemannic

		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes
				has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_yugoslav
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_result_gone
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_slovene_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_yugoslav_slovene
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_yugoslav_slovene
			var:te_cm_held_yugoslav_slovene < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_yugoslav_slovene
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_slovene_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_measured = yes
						te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_measured = yes
						te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_measured = yes
						te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene
			te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_yugoslav
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_yugoslav_opt_slovene_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_yugoslav_slovene

				te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes
				has_global_variable = te_cm_in_french
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_result_gone
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_french_catalan_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_french_catalan
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_french_catalan
			var:te_cm_held_french_catalan < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_french_catalan
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_french_catalan_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes
					OR = {
						te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
						te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_french
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_french
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_french_catalan
			te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_french
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_french
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_french_catalan
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_french_catalan
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_french_gate_ok = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_paused
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_french_opt_catalan_ready
	}
}

te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_american_afro_american_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
			NOT = {
				te_cm_gate_slavery_banned = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_joined_gate
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_american_afro_american
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_american_afro_american
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes
				has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_american
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_result_gone
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_american_afro_american_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_gate_slavery_banned = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_gate
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_american_afro_american
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_american_afro_american
			var:te_cm_held_american_afro_american < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_american_afro_american
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_american_afro_american_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
						te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
						te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_american
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_american
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_american_afro_american
			te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_american
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_american
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_american_afro_american
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_american_afro_american
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_american_afro_american_waiting = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_waiting
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_american_gate_ok = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_paused
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_american_opt_afro_american_ready
	}
}

		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_anglophone_scottish
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_anglophone_scottish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_scottish_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_anglophone_scottish
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_anglophone_scottish
			var:te_cm_held_anglophone_scottish < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
						te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
						te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
						te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
						te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_anglophone
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_anglophone
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_anglophone_scottish
			te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_anglophone
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_anglophone
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_anglophone_scottish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_anglophone_scottish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_gate_ok = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_paused
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_anglophone_opt_scottish_ready
	}
}

			has_variable = te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian
			te_cmg_brazilian_opt_afro_brazilian_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_brazilian_opt_afro_brazilian_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_brazilian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_brazilian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_brazilian_opt_afro_brazilian_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_brazilian_afro_brazilian
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_brazilian_opt_afro_brazilian_sol_result
	}
	text = {

				var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1

		localization_key = te_cmg_brazilian_opt_afro_brazilian_sol

te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_arab_sudanese_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_arab_sudanese
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_arab_sudanese
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_sudanese ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_arab_sudanese_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_arab_sudanese
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_arab_sudanese
			var:te_cm_held_arab_sudanese < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_arab_sudanese
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_arab_sudanese_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_measured = yes
						te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes
						te_cmg_arab_misri_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes
						te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes
						te_cmg_arab_bedouin_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes
						te_cmg_arab_yemenite_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_arab
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_arab
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese
			te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_arab
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_arab
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_arab_sudanese
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_arab_is_starter = yes
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_arab_gate_ok = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_paused
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_arab_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_arab_opt_sudanese_ready
	}
}

			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_persian_tajik
			te_cmg_persian_opt_tajik_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_tajik_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_persian_tajik
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_tajik_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_persian_tajik
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_tajik_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_tajik_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_tajik_ready_running
	}
	text = {

	}

			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_persian_hazara
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_persian_hazara
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_persian_hazara_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_persian_hazara
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_persian_hazara
			var:te_cm_held_persian_hazara < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_persian_hazara
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_persian_hazara_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes
					OR = {
						te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
						te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_persian_hazara
			te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_persian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_persian_hazara
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_persian_hazara
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_sol_result
	}
	text = {

		localization_key = te_cmg_persian_opt_hazara_sol

te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_dravidian_telegu
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_dravidian_telegu
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_dravidian_telegu
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_dravidian_telegu
			var:te_cm_held_dravidian_telegu < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_dravidian_telegu
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
						te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
						te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes
						te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_dravidian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_dravidian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_dravidian_telegu
			te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_dravidian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_dravidian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_dravidian_telegu
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_dravidian_telegu
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_dravidian_opt_telegu_ready
	}
}

	}

		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_joined_hold

		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes
				has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_indonesian
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_result_gone
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_balinese_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_indonesian_balinese
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_indonesian_balinese
			var:te_cm_held_indonesian_balinese < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes
						te_cmg_indonesian_javan_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes
						te_cmg_indonesian_malay_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
						te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
						te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_indonesian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_indonesian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_indonesian_balinese
			te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_sol_wide
	}
	text = {

			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_indonesian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_indonesian
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_indonesian_balinese
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_indonesian_opt_balinese_sol_close
	}
	text = {

			NOT = {

		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_platinean_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_platinean_ready
	}

te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_latin_cm_platine_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_platine
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_latin_cm_platine
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_latin_cm_platine
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_latin_cm_platine_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_latin_cm_platine
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_latin_cm_platine
			var:te_cm_held_latin_cm_platine < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_cm_platine
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_latin_cm_platine_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes
						te_cmg_latin_french_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes
						te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes
						te_cmg_latin_spanish_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes
						te_cmg_latin_portuguese_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_latin
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_latin
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_latin_cm_platine
			te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_latin
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_latin
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_latin_cm_platine
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_latin_cm_platine
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_latin_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_latin_opt_cm_platine_ready
	}
}

te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_pan_slavic_polish
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_slavic_polish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_polish
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_pan_slavic_polish
			var:te_cm_held_pan_slavic_polish < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_slavic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_slavic_polish
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_slavic_opt_polish_ready
	}

			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_bashkir
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_bashkir_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_bashkir ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_bashkir
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_bashkir_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_bashkir ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_bashkir_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_bashkir_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_bashkir_ready
	}
}

te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar = {
	type = country
	random_valid = no
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar_switched_in = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_switched
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_switched_away
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			has_variable = te_cm_held_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_joined_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_joined_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_dom_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_joined
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_joined_new
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar_available = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_busy
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_tech
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_unmeasured
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
			var:te_cm_held_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes
						te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_pan_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_pan_turkic
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_sol_result
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_sol
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_starter = yes
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_ready_running
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = te_cmg_pan_turkic_opt_crimean_tatar_ready
	}
}

			}
			has_variable = te_cm_held_east_african_yao
			var:te_cm_held_east_african_yao < te_cm_hold_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_hold
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_accept
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_yao
			NOT = {
				te_cmg_east_african_yao_years_met = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_years
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						te_cmg_east_african_swahili_measured = yes
						te_cmg_east_african_swahili_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_measured = yes
						te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_switched_in = yes
					}
					OR = {
						te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_measured = yes
						te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_switched_in = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_sol_core
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_east_african
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_east_african
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_east_african_yao
			te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_sol_gap >= te_cm_sol_gap_open
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_sol_wide
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_hi_east_african
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_lo_east_african
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_east_african_yao
		}
		localization_key = te_cmg_east_african_opt_yao_sol_close
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
			}
			has_variable = te_cm_sol_east_african_yao
		}
